in_use_evidence: No story or code at 2ed84b9 encodes the Or steps; QA strategy row DOM-04 only links the file, and no Gherkin runner or parser in CI reads gigacron.feature outside docs.
why: The Gherkin parser refuses the whole shared file, so any tool that reads it reports false or no Rules, which fails the purpose of a parseable spec.

in_use_evidence: Stories ST-0003B.md and ST-0003B-details.md only defer config_hash (T-0052) and build no column or index; no code at 7cd01b2 encodes the todo statements.
why: A planning agent that follows T-0052 to T-0054 as written builds a hash column and unique index the entity model forbids, so it reaches a wrong result.
rule_gap: In use says a document is in use when stories 'encode its statement'; it does not say whether a story that only defers and points at the statement counts.

in_use_evidence: No story or code at 7cd01b2 encodes the per-draft route POST /task-drafts/{id}/publish; ST-0003B.md:107 and routes.py implement /api/v1/publications instead.
why: Spec and delivered code name two incompatible publication contracts, so the next story cannot pick one without asking the stakeholder.

in_use_evidence: Undecided which side is wrong: code _require_publishable_drafts (definition_store_service.py:310) encodes the field-code form of interface-contracts.md:207-209, but no story or code encodes the TASK_DRAFT_INVALID form.
why: Two spec statements answer a nameless draft differently, so an implementer or test writer cannot satisfy both without asking which form is the target.
rule_gap: harms_downstream says 'the statement contradicts ... and code already encodes it'; when the finding does not name the wrong side, the rule does not say whether code that follows one side of a contradiction makes the finding critical.

in_use_evidence: Reviewed text: 'A draft whose content fails gets one problem for each field error' (docs/spec/supplementary_specs/interface-contracts.md:207). Code outside the run, on dev since 2026-10-26: _require_publishable_drafts returns 'one problem for each field error' (task_registry/services/definition_store_service.py:310) and test_publication_routes.py:316 asserts REQUIRED, REQUIRED.
why: The statement contradicts three artifacts of the publication rules, and the merged dev code and its test already build it, so the wrong contract is in use.
rule_gap: Same gap as SPEC-0015: whether the finding's own claim about which side is wrong may be taken as given for harms_downstream.

in_use_evidence: No story or code at bd9d718 encodes a publication gate; ST-0003 is status pending and the scope map correctly shows DOM-03 as specified.
why: The spec and scope map state the true position and the planned story builds the code, so no reader reaches a wrong result and nothing needs to change in the reviewed text.
rule_gap: Reconciliation kind code-defect in the document class: the tree asks about the document, and the rules do not say how to rate missing code for a story that is still pending.
